purpose: Documented draft seed research only. No Odoo records changed.
method: Focused Arabic and English public web searches for an official VAT registration number owned by each named entity. Excluded customer/applicant numbers, third-party supplier numbers, illustrative invoices, TIN, commercial registration and phone numbers.
status_definition: not_publicly_verified means no attributable official VAT number was verified in this bounded search; it does not mean the entity is unregistered or exempt.

entities.finding: Official investment opportunity requests the applicant's tax-number document; no Ministry-owned VAT number established.

queries: site.mc.gov.sa رقم التسجيل الضريبي وزارة التجارة
entities.finding: Official supervision form asks for the inspected establishment's VAT number, not the Ministry's.

queries: site.business.sa الرقم الضريبي المركز السعودي للأعمال الاقتصادية
entities.finding: Official brochure lists VAT registration and returns as services; no Center-owned VAT number established.

queries: وزارة الموارد البشرية والتنمية الاجتماعية الرقم الضريبي
entities.finding: Service guide includes VAT-certificate verification services; search also returned third-party registered organizations whose numbers are not the Ministry's.
Services page lists VAT registration/refund services for beneficiaries; no Ministry-owned VAT number established.

queries: site.moj.gov.sa رقم التسجيل الضريبي وزارة العدل
entities.finding: Estate-platform manual requests a transaction tax number; no Ministry-owned VAT number established.
No attributable official VAT-number result found; commercial service-provider and platform results cannot establish the Directorate's VAT number.

queries: site.gosi.gov.sa الرقم الضريبي المؤسسة العامة للتأمينات
المؤسسة العامة للتأمينات الاجتماعية رقم ضريبي
site.gosi.gov.sa VAT Number General Organization for Social Insurance
entities.finding: No attributable official VAT-number result found; taxpayer registration certificates mentioning GOSI relate to other organizations.

queries: site.zatca.gov.sa هيئة الزكاة والضريبة والجمارك VAT number
entities.finding: Official invoicing guide contains a clearly illustrative supplier invoice; its sample VAT number must not be assigned to ZATCA.

implementation_rule: Leave vat null until an official registration certificate, authoritative entity publication or a genuine issuer invoice establishes ownership and the VAT number is checked. Do not infer VAT rates or tax treatment from the supplier name or from a null VAT field.
